description: Lists programming guidelines: the coach's own rules for how AI builds workouts and programs, or the starter templates. Use when the user asks which training rules or methods the AI follows, or needs a guideline ID for create_similar_workout or create_similar_program. Not for workout categories (use list_workout_categories). Returns guideline names, IDs and which one is the default.

source.description: Which list: mine = the signed-in coach's guidelines (team ones included); templates = Hyperhuman starter templates. Defaults to mine.

name: list_programming_guidelines
title: List programming guidelines
